title: 自动化 PR Eval Framework (OpenAI Evals 借鉴)
scope:
1. OpenAI Evals: 'creating high-quality evals is among the most impactful activities for LLM development'
2. KALLAX 现状: 5-Level Verify 是人工评审, 无自动化 PR eval gate
3. 本 EPIC: pr-eval.sh 自动跑 lint + tsc + vitest, 每 PR merge 前必须 pass
4. 跟 EPIC-069-D (check-claim-evidence) / EPIC-117 (ACI) / EPIC-118 (expertise) 联合
5. 4-PR 流程 (feature → testing → main → miao, EPIC-074)
master_explicit_decision: 2026-07-14 主公 explicit '要' 落地 OpenAI Eval Framework. OpenAI: eval is most impactful activity. KALLAX PR gate 目前 5-Level Verify 人工, 需要自动化. 每 PR 必须跑 lint + tsc + vitest, 0 errors 才 merge.

checkin_points.gate: pr-eval.sh --pr N 输出: lint errors / tsc errors / vitest failures, 全部 0 才 PASS

tickets.title: scripts/verify/pr-eval.sh — 自动化 PR eval gate
tickets.acceptance: 接受 PR# 或 commit SHA, 跑 eslint + tsc + vitest, 输出 JSON {lint,tsc,vitest}, exit 0 仅当全部 0 errors

tickets.title: docs/pr-eval-guide.md — eval framework 文档
tickets.acceptance: 文档含: eval 原理 (OpenAI) + KALLAX PR gate 设计 + pr-eval.sh 用法 + exit code 说明
